objective: Log into the Acme Supply Hub supplier portal at http://localhost:8765/static/portal/index.html using email demo@acme.com and password demo1234. Complete the reCAPTCHA checkbox on step 2 and click Verify. Navigate to Orders, search for order PO-2024-8842, click the row to open order details, and extract the order JSON including line items. Then go to Invoices, click Download Summary for invoice INV-2024-3325, and extract the invoice summary JSON. Finally open Support, submit a ticket: category System Integration, subject API webhook delay, description EDI 856 acknowledgments are delayed by 2 hours since Nov 28. Return all extracted data.
success_criteria: Successfully logged in, extracted order PO-2024-8842 line items JSON, extracted invoice INV-2024-3325 summary with tax, and submitted a support ticket with a ticket ID.
